blurb: Airspan Helicopters provides a variety of helicopter flight operations including hot tub placement, construction material delivery, snowmobile recovery, logging operations, bucketing, crew moves, initial and expanded attack, and tours. They also offer fuel services with tanker trucks and drum fuel options, as well as ancillary services with specialized equipment and ground support personnel. Their fleet includes light, intermediate, and medium lift helicopters maintained at their Sechelt base.
